name: The Lantern Drowner
place: a light that bobs over the deepest pool of Brackwater Fen at dusk, pretending to be a lost traveller's lamp
_doc: Stream E (M2). A wisp that lures. Its Lantern Light puts a gold SAFE circle under it and darkens everything else — come close to be spared. It sends sparks after everyone (spread), and at half health splits off three little lights.

party.solo: Solo is fine as long as you walk INTO the light.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: "Over here! I have lost my way!" The voice comes from the light.
The lamp bobs closer. There is nobody holding it.
say.death: The Lantern Drowner gutters out with a sound like a sigh.
say.reset: The light drifts back over the deep water.

lure.name: Lantern Light
lure.say: The marsh goes black — come into the lantern light!

wisplets.name: Scattering Sparks
wisplets.say: Sparks cling to each of you — spread out!

drown.name: Drowning Pull
drown.say: The water tugs at your legs!
